title: Once a Tree, Always a Tree? Cross-lingual Transfer of Hierarchical Generalization in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models (LMs) often exhibit successful cross-lingual transfer through continued (pre)training, still their underlying process remains unclear. One possibility is that LMs can leverage the evidence toward language-universal principles, namely, hierarchical structure, from a source language (L1) to a new language (L2), while many other non-linguistic explanations, e.g., improved initialization of position embeddings, can be potentially possible. In this study, to quantify the cross-linguistic transferability of linguistic evidence in cross-lingual LM training, we introduce a new experimental design, namely, a cross-lingual poverty-of-stimulus (CPOS) setting that ablates how LMs' hierarchical generalization in L2 can be led by structural evidence provided in L1. translated_title: 一日为树，终身为树？语言模型中层级泛化的跨语言迁移
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）通过持续（预）训练往往能表现出成功的跨语言迁移，但其背后的机制仍不清楚。一种可能性是，语言模型能够利用源语言（L1）中指向语言普遍原则的证据——即层级结构——并将其应用于新语言（L2），但也可能存在许多其他非语言学层面的解释，例如位置嵌入初始化的改进等。在本研究中，为了量化跨语言训练中语言证据的跨语言可迁移性，我们引入了一种新的实验设计，即跨语言刺激贫乏（CPOS）设置，用以消融检验语言模型在第二语言中的层级泛化如何能够由第一语言所提供的结构证据来引导。我们对比了反事实的L1与L2学习场景：在这些场景中，L2语料库在线性语法规则和层级语法规则之间是模糊的，而正面证据的数量……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出跨语言刺激贫乏（CPOS）实验设置，证明语言模型在第二语言中的层级结构泛化可以由第一语言提供的结构证据驱动，从而支持层级结构作为语言普遍原则在跨语言迁移中被模型利用的观点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a cross-lingual poverty-of-stimulus (CPOS) setting showing that language models' hierarchical generalization in a second language can be driven by structural evidence from a first language, supporting the view that hierarchical structure serves as a language-universal principle leveraged in cross-lingual transfer.
